name: David Roberson

summary.text: David Lynn Roberson was Drummond Company's vice president of government and regulatory affairs. In July 2018 a federal jury in Birmingham convicted him and Balch & Bingham partner Joel Gilbert of bribery, honest services wire fraud, conspiracy and money laundering for paying state representative Oliver Robinson through a consulting contract to oppose EPA Superfund action in north Birmingham. He was sentenced to 30 months in prison; the Eleventh Circuit affirmed in May 2020. He has maintained his innocence.
